01Yinyang

Begin with understanding yourself, the model, and your relationship. Connect personal philosophy, collaboration, and the tool environment into a practice that can keep evolving.

Full · Empty — Full includes essays and diagrams; Empty keeps the dialectical core, formation guides, and unfilled personal structure for you and your model to develop.
